column7: sendMFAResetError answered an audit-log outage with its own 503 body (code AuditUnavailable, no Retry-After). It now goes through sendAuditUnavailable (Retry-After, code audit_unavailable) and the reset is not applied; the mapping guard exemption for the two handlers names #3858 (REVIEW-3838-DEEP-1 L3).
